name: zhihu/user-articles
description: Get articles published by a Zhihu user with offset pagination and publish-time or upvote sorting. Use it to browse a creator's articles in the selected order.

userUrlToken.description: Zhihu user URL token, such as the value in `zhihu.com/people/{userUrlToken}`.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Zhihu User Articles API This API returns a page of articles published by one Zhihu user. Each item has the title, excerpt, HTML content, vote and comment counts, and timestamps. You send the user's `userUrlToken`, and you can pick the sort order and the start offset. ## Use cases - Build a list of a creator's articles ordered by newest first with `sortType` set to `created`. - Find a creator's most upvoted articles by setting `sortType` to `voteups`. - Track comment, upvote and favorite counts on a creator's articles over time. - Collect article URLs and cover images to link a creator's work in a content database. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/user-articles" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"userUrlToken": "excited-vczh"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `userUrlToken` | string | Yes | Zhihu user URL token, such as the value in `zhihu.com/people/{userUrlToken}`. | | `offset` | integer | No | Start offset, begins with 0. | | `sortType` | string | No | Sorting criteria for user articles. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "data": [ { "admin_closed_comment": false, "article_type": "normal", "author": { "avatar_url": "https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-ada18a9354a3831171306f2c7ce20aaf_l.jpg?source=d16d100b", "avatar_url_template": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-ada18a9354a3831171306f2c7ce20aaf.jpg?source=d16d100b", "badge": [], "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": [], "icon": "", "merged_badges": [], "night_icon": "", "title": "" }, "gender": -1, "headline": "", "id": "0970f947b898ecc0ec035f9126dd4e08", "is_advertiser": false }, "can_comment": { "reason": "", "status": true }, "comment_count": 28, "comment_permission": "all", "content": "

思路已经有了，也开始做了。

早期GacUI为了跨平台精心设计了…", "content_need_truncated": false, "copyright_permission": "need_review", "created": 1705652701, "endorsements": [ { "background_color": { "alpha": 0.1, "group": "GBL01A" }, "elements": [ { "content": "创作声明: 内容包含剧透", "font_color": { "alpha": 1.0, "group": "GBL07A" }, "font_size": 13, "is_bold": true, "max_line": 1, "type": "TEXT" } ], "sub_elements": [ { "elements": [ { "content": "创作声明: 内容包含剧透", "font_color": { "alpha": 1.0, "group": "GBL07A" }, "font_size": 13, "is_bold": true, "max_line": 1, "type": "TEXT" } ] } ], "sub_elements_type": "DESCRIPTION" } ], "excerpt": "思路已经有了，也开始做了。早期GacUI为了跨平台精心设计了一套隔离层，可以把操作系统和渲染器的细节正交地隔离掉，后来在移植到macos和linux的时候，得到…" } ], "need_force_login": false, "paging": { "is_end": false, "is_start": true, "next": "http://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/members/excited-vczh/articles?user_url_token=excited…", "previous": "http://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/members/excited-vczh/articles?user_url_token=excited…", "totals": 147 } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].id / data[].url` | The article ID and its link on zhuanlan.zhihu.com. | | `data[].title` | Article title. | | `data[].excerpt / data[].content` | A short excerpt and the article body. Both are HTML strings and may be cut short. | | `data[].created / data[].updated` | Creation and last update times as Unix timestamps in seconds. | | `data[].voteup_count / data[].comment_count` | Number of upvotes and number of comments on the article. | | `data[].reaction.statistics.favorites / data[].reaction.statistics.like_count` | Number of favorites and number of likes on the article. | | `data[].image_url` | Cover image URL. It is an empty string when the article has no cover. | | `data[].author.id / data[].author.avatar_url` | The author's ID and avatar image URL. | | `data[].endorsements[]` | Optional labels on the article, such as a creation statement or the column that includes it. Text sits in `elements[].content` and a column link in `action_url`. | | `paging.totals / paging.is_end` | Total number of articles for this user, and whether the current page is the last one. | ## Notes - Take `userUrlToken` from the profile URL `zhihu.com/people/{userUrlToken}`. For example, `excited-vczh`. - Each page in the sample holds 20 items. The `paging.next` URL shows `limit=20&offset=20` for the next page, so send `offset` as 20, 40 and so on until `paging.is_end` is `true`. - `sortType` accepts `created` (default) or `voteups`. - To look up the author first, call [Zhihu User Info](/apis/zhihu/user-info). ## Pricing $0.014286 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization.
